title: Zoey message envelope
description: CONTRACT.md §3. Every WebSocket frame, both directions, is exactly this shape. One JSON object per text frame, UTF-8, max 1 MiB.

v.description: PROTOCOL_VERSION. Mismatch closes the connection with 4409.

id.description: ULID, unique per message. Commands are idempotent by this id (CONTRACT §3.3).

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC with exactly milliseconds precision.

type.description: Namespaced type. CONTRACT §3.1. Unknown types MUST be ignored, never error (§3.2).

corr.description: The `id` this message responds to. null for unsolicited events.

payload.description: Type-specific. May be empty. Unknown FIELDS inside a known payload MUST be ignored (§3.2).

$comment: additionalProperties:false applies to the ENVELOPE only. Payloads are deliberately open so that additive changes do not bump PROTOCOL_VERSION (CONTRACT §7.2).
